title: Oral iron supplementation for iron deficiency anemia
text: Oral ferrous sulfate remains the standard first-line treatment for iron deficiency anemia, replenishing iron stores required for hemoglobin synthesis in erythroid precursors. Gastrointestinal side effects are common and can be mitigated by alternate-day dosing regimens without compromising iron absorption.
